result.rationale: Defer the MN8 Energy ownership correction while preserving the verified research. Direct sources support Ridgewood's March 28, 2024 $125 million convertible-preferred investment through WSI Fund II Holdings and the signed but unclosed Greenbacker acquisition. The complete current common-owner table and stakes remain unresolved, so applying a partial ownership after-image would risk displacing valid active owners before legal closing.

Official investor-rights agreement identifying WSI Fund II Holdings and the March 28, 2024 investment.
Official transaction materials showing the Greenbacker acquisition remains signed and pending closing.
